QUOTE: If that define is set, the default is `platform_calloc_uninit` (`platform.c:25-33`), which always returns NULL. The same applies to free (`platform.c:36-45`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the uninit calloc always returns NULL, but it doesn't say that the uninit free does nothing, and "the same applies to free" doesn't state that. It also omits the fail-rather-than-fall-back framing.
